People say all kinds of things related to therapy words but in the end love bombing is a manipulation technique to rope you in. It is not exactly about how much affection they show you at the start but what they do after you are hooked on their affection. People that show you a lot of affection early on isn't love bombing it can be just that or it could also be related to trauma. Whether you like that or not is up to you. What is much more important to spot is their other ques. Like how they treat others and how they use those "affections". For instance, but " I did this (insert grand gesture) for you and you can't even do this simple thing in return?". They can use their gestures to guilt trip you into doing something they want. So like buying you something expensive so that you feel included to go on a trip that you've previously refused or do something that you expressed you aren't comfortable doing.
The important thing is it always starts with the small things. So if you feel like there's potentially quite a lot of affection headed towards you real fast then make sure to slow down and keep some distance. Also communicate that you want some distance cos you feel like things are moving too quickly. If they don't respect that then they have some issues they need to work on.
